description: Add sitelink sets. Each set contains a Sitelinks array of {Title, Href, Description} objects (2-8 sitelinks per set). Use when the user asks to create sitelink sets. Do not use it to delete a set; call delete_sitelinks. Do not use it to list sets; call get_sitelinks.

items_json.description: JSON array of sitelink set objects, e.g. [{"Sitelinks":[{"Title":"About","Href":"https://example.com/about"},{"Title":"Contacts","Href":"https://example.com/contacts"}]}]

name: add_sitelinks
